name: names-in-the-plan
description: Action items are given to people by name, but each person also speaks after being addressed.
lines: Last item, the conference booth. Rochelle, can you confirm the booth size with the organisers?
Yes, I'll email them today. I think we booked the six by three metre one.
Thanks Rochelle. Ola, you were looking at the printing?
I've got two quotes, I'll pick the cheaper one unless anyone objects to the paper stock.
No objection from me. Thanks Ola.
